name: Chol'aruk the Ravener
summary: On Thorn Hill in the Barrens, Chol'aruk the Ravener haunts a cave. Bainham seeks its severed head to avenge comrades slain by beasts like it.

sections.title: Terror of Thorn Hill
sections.body: Northwest of Bainham's camp, Thorn Hill rises above the Barrens Savannah. The Razormane tribes have long fought over its plateau. Now a monstrous abomination is said to lurk in one of its caves. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or the Ravener. Some travelers doubt the tale that it can swallow an armored orc whole. Those who have seen the carnage know the danger is real.

sections.title: A Grudge Repaid
sections.body: Bainham knows Chol'aruk is no campfire tale. He has fought similar horrors and carries scars from those encounters. His comrades fell to such beasts, and he still mourns them. He fears the abomination threatens everyone crossing the Savannah. Bainham asks seasoned champions to climb Thorn Hill, enter its underground lair, slay Chol'aruk, and bring back its massive head.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Chol'aruk?
faq.answer: Chol'aruk is a monstrous abomination in a cave on Thorn Hill. Rumors say it can swallow a grown orc whole, and the Razormane call it the Ravener.
Chol'aruk lairs in a cave on Thorn Hill's high plateau, northwest in the Barrens.

faq.q: Who is Bainham and why does he want Chol'aruk dead?
faq.answer: Bainham lives in the Barrens and has fought beasts like Chol'aruk. He wants it dead to avenge the allies he lost to such abominations.
The Razormane quilboar call Chol'aruk the Ravener, a name tied to its ravenous nature. Rumors say it devours full-grown warriors whole.

faq.q: Do the Razormane quilboar worship or fear Chol'aruk?
faq.answer: No one knows whether the Razormane quilboar fear or worship Chol'aruk. They call it Chol'aruk or the Ravener, but nothing more is known of their feelings toward the abomination in Thorn Hill's cave.

faq.q: What proof is required to confirm Chol'aruk's death?
faq.answer: Bainham asks you to bring back Chol'aruk's severed head as proof of its death.

angles.text: Unchecked monsters on the high plateaus threaten travelers and caravans crossing the Barrens. Slaying this beast would help protect the region.
As a hunter, tracking a predator rumored to swallow fully armored warriors whole will test your skill and nerve.
As a warrior, you can answer Bainham's call by facing a towering horror in its underground lair and avenging fallen comrades.
